title: My hobby profile

prepTasks.correct: Я занимаюсь этим... раз в неделю.

writingModel: My name is Aibek Dosov and I am a History student at WKU. In this text, I want to write about two hobbies: my own hobby, and the hobby of my best friend Samal. We have very different passions, but we both love what we do. I believe that hobbies are one of the most important things in a student's life — they give us energy, identity, and joy outside the classroom.

My favourite hobby is playing guitar. I play for about one hour every evening after I finish my homework. I started this hobby when I was 14 years old — I taught myself using free YouTube tutorials. At first, I could only play three chords. Now I know more than 25 songs and I sometimes play for my friends in the dormitory common room. My favourite songs to play are Kazakh folk music and classic rock. Music helps me think clearly and relax completely after a long day of reading History textbooks.

I love guitar because it gives me something that books cannot — it gives me a voice. When I play, I forget about exams, deadlines, and stress. I feel free and creative. Playing music also builds patience: I practised the same chord for two weeks before it sounded right. This patience helps me in my studies too. I want to write my own songs one day — maybe about WKU student life!

My best friend Samal has a completely different hobby: photography. She carries her camera everywhere she goes — to lectures, to the cafeteria, to the park, and even on early morning walks before sunrise. She wakes up at 6 am on weekends just to catch the perfect morning light on the steppe. She posts her three best photos every week on Instagram, where she already has more than 1,400 followers. She says that photography teaches her to see beauty in ordinary things. She is passionate about her art and she improves every single week.

Aibek plays guitar and Samal takes photos — we are very different. But we both do something we love every single day, and we both support each other's passions. Last Sunday, we went hiking together: I played guitar at the top of the hill, and Samal photographed the landscape. It was one of the best afternoons of the semester! I believe that every student at WKU has a special hobby waiting to be discovered. Find yours, practise it with dedication, and share it with the world!
